w, m = map(int, input().split())

if w <= 3:
    print("YES")
    exit()

nDigits = 0
val = 1
bases = []

while val <= 2e9:
    bases.append(val)
    val *= w
    nDigits += 1

values = [-1] * nDigits
curTotal = -sum(bases)
works = False

while True:
    index = 0
    while True:
        values[index] += 1
        curTotal += bases[index]
        if values[index] != 2:
            if abs(curTotal) == m:
                works = True
            break
        else:
            values[index] = -1
            curTotal -= bases[index] * 3
            index += 1
            if index == nDigits:
                break
    if index == nDigits:
        break

print("YES" if works else "NO")
</translated_code>
